text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release 2026.03.21-rc4 -> service/embed-route. Rolling 20% canary (eu-west primary), triggered by @alice. Rollout id: rlt-20260321-rc4. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys
alice: Kicking off watch on SLOs + error dashboards. I'll focus on eu-west and us-east traces.
ben: Noted. Watching p50/p95. Quick heads-up: p95 in eu-west at ~380ms (baseline ~180ms). No 5xx spike right now.
carol: I see the same on the per-route SLO panel. Error budget slope trending up slightly for embed-route (small %). Alerts haven't escalated yet.
dave: Can someone paste the prometheus query you used for p95?
alice: Here: ```
# p95 embed latency (eu-west)
quantile_over_time(0.95, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embed"}[5m])) by (le,instance))[5m:1m])
```
monitoring-bot: ALERT (warning): embed-p95-eu-west crossed threshold 350ms at 7077777020 — alert id a-embed-350-warn.
ben: I grabbed a couple of traces from the canary nodes. Root cause looks like more KV cache misses on the new runtime build in eu-west; increased cold-kv hits + slightly higher decode time.
carol: Options: rollback to previous build, pause rollout and pin eu-west traffic to previous model variant, or try quick cache/TLS tweak on canary nodes.
alice: I'm inclined to PAUSE at 20% and run a quick cache TTL bump for canary nodes in eu-west. We can revert if no improvement. Anyone object?
dave: fine with pause, I can push TTL bump (5m -> 15m) in eu-west canary pool and watch.
carol: Agreed. If TTL bump doesn't drop p95 in 10m, we'll rollback.
alice: @deploy-bot pause-rollout rlt-20260321-rc4 --scope eu-west --reason "p95 bump, trying cache TTL tweak"
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused at 20% for rollout rlt-20260321-rc4 by @alice. Audit: action=pause, scope=eu-west, ts=7077777028.
dave: Pushing TTL change to canary nodes now — patch id patch-ttl-442. Applying to eu-west-canary pool.
ben: Traces post-TTL patch show fewer KV misses already. p95 dropping.
monitoring-bot: UPDATE: embed-p95-eu-west now 210ms at 7077777040 (was 380ms). Alert a-embed-350-warn cleared.
alice: Nice. Resume plan: resume to 50% in 10m and keep extra SLO sampling for eu-west for 30m. Create a follow-up ticket to dig into why the runtime caused extra KV churn.
carol: I'll add a note to release notes: "canary paused at 20% in eu-west for cache TTL tweak; resumed after improvement" and attach traces.
dave: Filing ticket: INF-9142 "Investigate KV misses on rc4 in eu-west".
ben: LGTM. I'll keep an eye on p95 and trace waterfall for the next hour.
alice: Thanks everyone. Closing this watch thread when the rollout hits 50% and stable for 30m.
